title: IIVXAvatar Interop Spec v1
description: Cross-platform avatar interoperability standard. Pillar 2 deliverable: GLB/GLTF + Ready Player Me-style blendshapes + canonical bone naming so Quest, Vision Pro, WebXR, Unreal, and Unity peers render each other correctly.

asset_url.description: GLB/GLTF download URL or content-addressed hash (sha256:...).

bone_standard.description: Canonical bone naming standard. ivx-bone-v1 maps to Mixamo + RPM with the IVX prefix.

blendshape_set.description: Blendshape vocabulary. Renderers MUST drive only these names.

fidelity_level.description: 0 = full body + face + fingers; 1 = full body + face; 2 = upper body + face; 3 = head + hands only (Quest first-person).

joint_layout.description: Canonical joint indices used in PoseUpdateFull / PoseUpdateDelta. Senders MUST use these indices; receivers MUST tolerate missing optional joints.

viseme_index.description: 15-state IPA-derived viseme indices used in VisemeFrame.viseme_index.

coordinate_system.description: All transforms are right-handed, Y-up, meters. Engines that ship Z-up or left-handed coords MUST convert at the adapter boundary.

physics_assumptions.description: Engines MUST disable rigid-body sim on remote avatars; pose comes from the wire. Local first-person rig is up to the engine.
